title: Contact — Council of AI measurement
description: Book a Results-as-a-Service call or ask about Professional / Business / Enterprise measurement with Council of AI. Signed measurement packs, never certification.
text: Contact — Council of AI measurement Home Master Sovereign GovBench Pricing Products Council FAQ Article 50 Contact — Result-as-a-Service & measurement Tell us what you need measured. We reply with a fixed-scope signed-pack quote (£500–£5,000) — delivered as an Ed25519-signed, timestamped, externally-verifiable measurement credential. We measure; we never certify, accredit, underwrite, or sell remediation to the party we measure. What we measure Article 50 evidence pack — signed transparency/marking evidence for GPAI providers & deployers (deadline 2 Dec 2026). AI-liability underwriting input — independent governance measurements insurers/MGAs can price against (neutral, non-conflicted). Model / agent governance pack — measured behaviour on the GSPC axes for procuring teams or auditors. Tender / procurement evidence kit — reusable signed attachments for public-sector or enterprise bids. Day-0 audit of a fresh open-weight drop — a signed self-audit within the release news cycle. Get started Email hello@csoai.org with the three lines: which pack · what to measure · deadline (if any) . We respond within 2 business days with a fixed scope and price. No obligation. Every delivered pack is signed on our keystone and timestamped on an independent calendar — you can verify it without trusting us. CSOAI Ltd · UK company 16939677 · Measurement, never certification · Every figure traces to a signed, verifiable record.

register.note: CSOAI measures and publishes evidence. It issues no conformity marks and holds no accreditation. Nothing here is certification or legal advice.
